properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure automated integrity verification tools are centrally managed, integrated into incident response, and used to detect and notify unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information. (Infra-Security-98).

metadata.Description:
Detection and Notification
Incident Response Integration
for more details - refer to Control statement
Detection and Notification
1. Configure the integritiy monitoring system to detect and notify on unauthorized changes:
- Real-time alerts for critical file modifications
- Automated incident creation for unauthorized changes
- Integration with SIEM for centralized logging and correlation
Incident Response Integration
1. Integrates the integrity verification tools into its incident response process:
- Automated ticket creation in the incident management system
- Predefined playbooks for different types of integrity violations
- Integration with security orchestration and automated response (SOAR) platform"
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure automated integrity verification tools are centrally managed, integrated into incident response, and used to detect and notify unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
